about: (2026-11-17, pipefix: the slot-count check was when 'match', which needs stage 2 -- a Regular-mode match driven through the menus has stage 0 throughout, so it could never pass (qa084); now any row of the match, mode -2 with its clock running.) 2026-11-15 (gameplayfix, item 10): the Royal Rumble's own rows (IN THE RING AT ONCE, ENTRY TIME, STARTS WITH) for an ORDER other than Random. Regular, Multi Play > Royal Rumble > ORDER row 2 as shown (qa_reg_order 2; Random is label 0x8522 -- LOOK at the ORDER page's shot: which row was taken) > NUMBER: the rows are up (shot), the driver (qa_reg 2305) presses UP x3 (the game's own NUMBER, by fours for this ORDER), RIGHT, UP x2, RIGHT, DOWN x2, RIGHT, UP -> ring 8, every 20 s, STARTS WITH 4; A; the select picks every entrant (A on the cursor). Expect: the match with ring 8 (slots >= 8: the mod fills the ring for the picked ORDER, gm_fill_ring), every 20 s, four at the bell. For the teams ORDER (0x10000) the ring row is hidden and the ring stays the four teams: then only the interval / four-at-the-bell checks hold

expect.name: the match as the page set it: ring 8, every 20 s, live
the match has room for 8 (its slot count)
four in the ring at the bell (STARTS WITH 4)
expect.check: mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30 and match_frames < 150 and in_ring == 4
